sources.name: IFRC GO appeals API (goadmin.ifrc.org/api/v2/appeal/): active appeals, and every appeal since ten years ago for each country's own record
sources.licence: IFRC GO terms and conditions (read 16 Nov 2026 from the GO web app's source, IFRCGo/go-web-app): data visible to everyone; non-commercial use such as research; maps, charts and analyses allowed; no copying or redistribution of the data bank or a substantial part of it. Published: active and recent appeals as facts with a link; the ten-year read is used for counts only

sources.name: WHO Disease Outbreak News API (www.who.int/api/news/diseaseoutbreaknews), two pages of 100
sources.licence: WHO website terms of use (read 16 Nov 2026): extracts may be reproduced for research, not for commercial purposes, with acknowledgement of WHO; substantial portions need written permission. Published: title, date, place read from the title, and a link; no notice text

sources.name: HDX HAPI (hapi.humdata.org/api/v2): coordination-context/funding (OCHA FTS) and metadata/resource; the app identifier is sent as a header
sources.licence: HAPI terms of service (docs.humdata.org, read 18 Nov 2026) set no data licence of their own: limits are 10,000 rows a call and about one call a second; each HDX dataset's licence governs onward sharing (HDX terms of service, clauses 11 and 12). Funding dataset global-requirements-and-funding-data: CC BY-IGO 3.0, read from HDX's catalogue every run; rows are published only when their dataset's licence is open

sources.name: HDX HAPI affected-people/humanitarian-needs (OCHA HPC, Humanitarian Needs Overviews), country totals only
sources.licence: CC BY-IGO 3.0 (HDX dataset global-hpc-hno, read every run from HDX's catalogue)

sources.name: HDX catalogue (data.humdata.org/api/3/action/package_show): each HAPI dataset's licence, read every run
sources.licence: Metadata only; nothing from it is published but the licence name. If it cannot be read, the licence recorded on 18 Nov 2026 is used and the lane says so

sources.name: ReliefWeb API (api.reliefweb.int/v2): disasters marked ongoing or alert, and report counts by main country and by disaster (facets); the pre-approved appname is a query parameter added at request time and never recorded
sources.licence: ReliefWeb terms and conditions (reliefweb.int/terms-conditions, read 18 Nov 2026; the API docs say they govern the API): personal, non-commercial use, with no right to redistribute, compile or create derivative works; materials may belong to their original sources. API limits: 1,000 calls a day and 1,000 entries a call per appname. Published: counts, ids (ReliefWeb id, GLIDE), types, countries, status, dates and links only; never ReliefWeb's disaster names or descriptions, or any report's title or text

sources.name: IPC food insecurity phases: the IPC API (token by request) and HAPI's food-security endpoint (HDX dataset global-acute-food-insecurity-country-data)
sources.licence: Conflict, read 18 Nov 2026: HDX lists the dataset as public domain (CC0), while IPC's own API terms of use (v2.0, March 2023) give CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 IGO and forbid any use for military purposes. Held: no IPC figure is read or published while IPC's terms conflict with HDX's listing

sources.name: HAPI coordination-context/conflict-events (ACLED)
sources.licence: ACLED's own terms of use and attribution policy (HDX licence Other); not read: conflict events are Watchfloor's ground

sources.name: IOM Displacement Tracking Matrix
sources.licence: Terms forbid redistribution and derivative works: link only. HAPI's idps endpoint carries DTM data under the same terms (HDX dataset global-iom-dtm-from-api, licence Other, read 18 Nov 2026), so it is not read
